items.title: Election Day storm could impact voter turnout in key midterm races in the central US
items.brief: A soggy storm will track through the central United States on Election Day and could influence voter turnout for key races in the region .

items.brief: An October surprise has surfaced in a race that could well determine who wins the Senate majority in next week’s midterm elections.

items.title: Dolores Huerta, pioneering labor leader and civil rights icon, dies at 96
items.brief: Dolores Huerta, a pioneering labor organizer and civil rights icon who cofounded the United Farm Workers with Cesar Chavez in the 1960s, died at 96, her family said in a statement Wednesday.

items.title: ‘It’s big’: Astronomers make startling discovery of a possible dwarf planet beyond Pluto
items.brief: Astronomers have spotted a new dwarf planet candidate in the solar system, beyond the orbit of Pluto, which they provisionally named ED138.

items.title: Manhunt for escaped Tennessee murder convict crosses state lines after the truck he stole is found abandoned in Illinois
items.brief: The search for a convicted murderer who escaped from a Tennessee prison has crossed state lines after authorities found his stolen getaway truck in southern Illinois.

items.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lands in US after fleeing Brazil following election defeat
items.brief: Brazilian senator Flávio Bolsonaro has landed in the US after fleeing Brazil following defeat in the country’s presidential election on Sunday.
